items.name: Airlie Oak Wilmington Printed Garment-Dyed Tee
items.alt: Ivory tee printed on the chest with a painterly illustration of the Airlie Oak, a Southern live oak with hanging Spanish moss, hanging from a live oak branch in a garden of azaleas, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A relaxed garment-dyed tee printed with a painterly illustration of the Airlie Oak, the roughly 500 year old Southern live oak at Airlie Gardens in Wilmington NC, with Spanish moss and blush azaleas. Made to order.
facts: Relaxed fit, offered in sizes L to 3XL (S and M are not offered yet)
Heavyweight 6.1 oz ring-spun cotton, pre-shrunk, double-needle stitching, no side seams
Airlie Oak illustration printed on the front chest, not embroidered
